g.text: One flaw at a time inflates AUC

g.text: Without evaluation leakage, T2WI radiomics and deep learning did not detect muscle invasion better than tumour size;

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #ffffff

g.text: single evaluation flaws inflated AUCs up to the near-perfect values reported in the literature.
